topic: Why your family health history matters

scenes.line: Do you know what runs in your family?
scenes.visual: Dr. Ira faces camera with a curious, friendly look, head tilted slightly, open-palm gesture; a small teal question-mark bubble appears beside him
scenes.animation: Question bubble pops in on 'know', scale 0.4 to 1.0, back.out 0.3 s; gentle wobble on 'family'

scenes.line: Most people have at least one chronic, or long-lasting, disease in the family,
scenes.visual: Simple three-generation family tree of round avatar nodes joined by teal lines; one node gets a soft orange ring
scenes.animation: Tree lines draw top to bottom on 'people', nodes scale in stagger 0.08 s, power2.out; orange ring pulses on 'chronic'; label 'long-lasting' fades in on 'long-lasting'

scenes.line: like cancer, heart disease or diabetes.
scenes.visual: Dr. Ira, calm and explaining, counts on his fingers; three rounded label cards line up above him: ribbon, heart, blood-drop
scenes.animation: Each card drops in on its word: ribbon on 'cancer', heart on 'heart', drop on 'diabetes', y 40 to 0, back.out 0.3 s

scenes.line: Ask your parents, siblings and grandparents
scenes.visual: Dr. Ira, warm smile, gestures outward as if inviting a chat; three relative chips appear at the sides
scenes.animation: Chips pop in on 'parents', 'siblings', 'grandparents', scale 0 to 1, back.out 0.3 s

scenes.line: which conditions they have or had, and how old they were when it started.
scenes.visual: Notebook page with two handwritten-style prompts: 'Which condition?' and 'Age it started?', each with a teal tick box
scenes.animation: Notebook slides up on 'which'; first prompt writes in on 'conditions', second on 'old'; ticks draw on 'had' and 'started', power2.out

scenes.line: Age matters. A parent or sibling with colorectal cancer before age 50
scenes.visual: Large rounded badge reading 'before 50' beside a parent-and-sibling icon pair and a small colon-ribbon icon
scenes.animation: Badge scales 0.5 to 1.0 on 'Age', back.out 0.35 s; icon pair slides in on 'parent'; '50' counts up from 0 on '50', power1.out 0.5 s

scenes.line: may mean asking your doctor about earlier screening.
scenes.visual: Dr. Ira, reassuring nod, palm up; a calendar card with an arrow moving to an earlier date appears beside him
scenes.animation: Calendar card fades in on 'asking'; arrow slides left to an earlier date on 'earlier', power2.inOut 0.4 s

scenes.line: A family history doesn't mean you will get a disease.
scenes.visual: A dial labelled 'risk' with the needle settling in the middle, next to the words 'not certainty'
scenes.animation: Dial draws in on 'family'; needle swings and settles mid-way on 'doesn't', elastic.out 0.6 s; 'not certainty' fades in on 'disease'

scenes.line: Healthy habits, like not smoking and staying active, can often lower your risk.
scenes.visual: Dr. Ira, upbeat, gives a small wave; a no-smoking icon and a walking-shoe icon float at the sides, a downward arrow labelled 'risk' between
scenes.animation: No-smoking icon pops on 'smoking', shoe on 'active', back.out 0.3 s; arrow slides down on 'lower', power2.out

scenes.line: Write it down and bring it to your next check-up.
scenes.visual: Notepad with a pencil writing three short lines, then the notepad slides into a clinic-building outline
scenes.animation: Pencil lines draw left to right on 'Write', stagger 0.15 s; notepad slides right into the clinic on 'bring', power2.inOut 0.5 s

scenes.line: Even a partial history helps your doctor plan your screening.
scenes.visual: Dr. Ira, encouraging smile, holds up an open hand; a half-filled checklist card appears beside him
scenes.animation: Checklist card slides in on 'partial'; first two ticks draw on 'helps', power2.out

scenes.line: Share this with your family, and start that conversation.
scenes.visual: Dr. Ira, direct friendly gaze, waves; a share-arrow icon and a speech-bubble icon appear above
scenes.animation: Share icon bounces in on 'Share', scale 0.8 to 1.1 to 1.0, back.out; speech bubble pops on 'conversation'

scenes.visual: Cream end card with Pulse Health wordmark centred
